name: Mark L. Taylor
bio: Mark Lawrence Taylor (born October 25, 1950) is an American actor, known for his roles in such films as Innerspace (1987), Honey, I Shrunk the Kids (1989), Arachnophobia (1990), and High School Musical 2 (2007), as well as television series such as House Calls (1979), Superman (1988) and The Mask: Animated Series (1995–97).
